feature: Customer Portal v2 -- THE SHELL'S FIVE SYSTEMS (Part 1), recreated from 'Customer Portal Shell.dc.html'. The global chrome that renders on every /portal-v2 page: the command palette (Cmd-K), ShaneBot (selection chip + chat panel + launcher), the alerts tray with real smart alerts and a hold-windows section, the account menu, the New menu, the knowledge-base overlay, and the change-control header badge. All UI-only against the design's own fixtures in components/portal-v2/shell/; the palette ranking + 14-cap are unit-tested in shell/paletteIndex.test.ts.
notes: THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL. /portal-v2/* sits behind ProtectedRoute.
UI ROUTE SHAPE: /portal/{slug}/portal-v2. The shell chrome renders on every portal-v2 page; this exercises it from the Overview.

shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree -- these brand-new testids assert green only after the pushed commit is deployed. Before that, the header still renders (search trigger, alerts bell, account chip) but the new controls (cc-badge, New, ?, and the overlays) are absent.

MUTUAL EXCLUSIVITY + OVERLAYS: each header dropdown is toggled by its own anchor and closed again before the next is opened, because the palette / KB overlays cover the header when open. The palette is exercised last and left open.

PALETTE RANKING IS UNIT-TESTED, NOT ASSERTED HERE: shell/paletteIndex.test.ts pins the exact-> prefix-> contains-> sub/kind order and the 14 cap (npm test, 13 cases). This manifest proves the palette MOUNTS, indexes a real count, and turns a typed query into the always-last Ask-ShaneBot row.
TEXTCONTAINS asserts the element's REAL rendered text; an array is ANY-of, so every all-of assertion is its own step (per the standing test-coverage rule).
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.
